thread:
Ava (Content): Kicking off the Mini RefKit OSS launch — deliverables: short launch post, reproducible bench blurb, 60m webinar (40m demo+bench + 20m hands-on lab). :sparkles:
Raj (DevRel): Lab target 25-30 mins. Repo layout: /quickstart, /bench, /templates, /lab-notebook, /faq. Make every command copy-paste friendly.
Sam (PM): Bench story should show p95 latency @256 tokens, median tokens/sec, and a small cost comparison vs hosted for single-request bursts. Need CSV and a single chart.
Noah (SRE): I'll run bench on a GPU node and a CPU-edge sim and upload CSV + tiny plots. Quick bench command to include:
```
./tools/bench --model mini-ref --seq 256 --concurrency 2
```
Evelyn (Growth): Landing CTA must include utm=mini_refkit_launch and feed into HubSpot. Promo plan: teaser tweet, webinar, two reminders, post-webinar drip. Need two short exec quotes for press.
Ava (Content): Draft headline idea: "Mini RefKit: a quickstart reference app for private LLM inference." I'll draft blog + 4-part tweet thread by Tue EOD.
Raj (DevRel): Speakers: Raj (DevRel) + Sam (Product) + Noah (Ops). Agenda: 20m demo, 20m bench & tradeoffs, 20m lab. Record and add repo action to re-run bench.
launch-bot: Reminder: schedule webinar >= 21 days out using template "webinar-standard".
Noah (SRE): Action items: bench CSV, compact Docker image, single-file k8s manifest, telemetry snippet that prints latency and tokens/sec to stdout.
Evelyn (Growth): Inbound routing: registrants -> list "mini_refkit_regs"; attended -> tag mini_refkit:attended; >2 opens -> mark warm and notify AE channel. Add utm tagging on reg form.
Ava (Content): Tiny demo snippet for the blog:
```
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 redwood/mini-refkit:latest
curl -sS http://localhost:8080/gen -d '{"prompt":"Explain this repo"}'
```
Sam (PM): I'll write the bench narrative and speaker notes. Dry-run one week before.
Ava (Content): Owners recap: Ava -> blog + tweets; Raj -> repo + lab guide; Noah -> bench + artifacts; Sam -> bench narrative + speaker notes; Evelyn -> landing page + HubSpot. I'll assemble a launch checklist when first drafts land.
Raj (DevRel): Starting repo scaffold now; will push initial commit today.
Noah (SRE): Bench runs scheduled tomorrow AM; will share CSV and short summary here.
Ava (Content): Great — keeping this thread as single source-of-truth. Thanks everyone :rocket:
